sources.literal_candidate: [NPC] Ryan: Welcome fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. I am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.
